name: vcs-workflow
description: Per-prompt version-control workflow reminder for Claude Code agents. Detects the repo type (jj-colocated, pure-jj, or pure-git) and injects a matching scope-classification + push-to-active-branch decision tree before every edit, so the agent describes changes early, keeps orthogonal work apart, and pushes to the active branch's upstream instead of defaulting to main.
